page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, the instance provides direct physical core allocation without hyperthreading, ensuring predictable compute performance.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. This 1:8 core-to-memory ratio positions the server within the memory-optimized category. No local storage is bundled with this instance type, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high memory density represent a hardware profile tailored for workloads requiring predictable CPU performance and substantial memory capacity without the overhead of shared-thread virtualization. Appropriate workloads include memory-intensive databases, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
